# teltonika_rms_task_group (Resource)

Creates and manages a device task group (`POST /devices/tasks/groups`, `PUT /devices/tasks/groups/{id}`, `DELETE /devices/tasks/groups/{id}`). A task group bundles an ordered set of tasks (shell commands, file uploads, file downloads) that RMS can execute against a set of devices; the group also optionally tags devices with success/failure markers.

The `tasks` attribute is a list of task objects. Each entry can be written inline, or supplied as a reference to a `teltonika_rms_task_group_task` state-only resource — both compile to the same plan since Terraform treats the resource reference as an object with the matching attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "teltonika_rms_current_user" "me" {}

resource "teltonika_rms_tag" "zero_touch_ok" {
  name        = "zero-touch-ok"
  description = "Devices that have completed zero-touch provisioning."
  color       = "#4287f5"
  company_id  = data.teltonika_rms_current_user.me.company_id
}

resource "teltonika_rms_tag" "zero_touch_failed" {
  name        = "zero-touch-failed"
  description = "Devices where zero-touch provisioning failed at some step."
  color       = "#e53935"
  company_id  = data.teltonika_rms_current_user.me.company_id
}

# Two reusable task definitions declared as state-only helpers. Neither of these
# resources talks to RMS — they hold typed task records so the group below can
# splice them into its `tasks` list. See the resource docs page.

resource "teltonika_rms_task_group_task" "update" {
  name            = "Update firmware"
  order           = 1
  type            = "command"
  timeout         = 120
  stop_on_failure = true

  data = {
    command = "echo 'pretend firmware update'"
  }
}

resource "teltonika_rms_task_group_task" "configure" {
  name            = "Push configuration"
  order           = 2
  type            = "command"
  timeout         = 60
  stop_on_failure = true

  data = {
    command          = file("${path.module}/configure.sh")
    acceptable_codes = [0, 2]
  }
}

resource "teltonika_rms_task_group" "zero_touch" {
  name       = "ZeroTouch"
  company_id = data.teltonika_rms_current_user.me.company_id

  success_tag_ids = [teltonika_rms_tag.zero_touch_ok.id]
  failed_tag_ids  = [teltonika_rms_tag.zero_touch_failed.id]

  # Terraform accepts either a resource reference (each state-only record above
  # is treated as an object with matching attributes) or an inline literal.
  tasks = [
    teltonika_rms_task_group_task.update,
    teltonika_rms_task_group_task.configure,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Task group name.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) Ordered list of tasks in the group. Each entry mirrors the OpenAPI `device_task_groups_create_tasks` shape. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

### Optional

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the company that owns the group. Defaults to the token's company when omitted.
- `failed_tag_ids` (List of Number) Tag ids attached to a device when the group fails against it.
- `success_tag_ids` (List of Number) Tag ids attached to a device when the whole group succeeds against it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of group creation.
- `id` (String) RMS-assigned identifier of the task group.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent update.

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Required:

- `data` (Attributes) Type-specific payload. Only the fields matching `type` are used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks--data))
- `name` (String) Task name.
- `order` (Number) Execution order within the group; must be >= 0.
- `stop_on_failure` (Boolean) Abort the remaining tasks if this one fails.
- `timeout` (Number) Runtime cap in seconds (1–300).
- `type` (String) Task type. One of `command`, `upload_file`, `download_file`.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) RMS-assigned task identifier (populated on read).

<a id="nestedatt--tasks--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks.data`

Optional:

- `acceptable_codes` (List of Number) Exit codes not treated as failure (type `command`).
- `command` (String) Shell command (type `command`).
- `file` (String) Source path on the device (type `download_file`).
- `file_id` (Number) Id of the file to push (type `upload_file`).
- `target_path` (String) Destination path on the device (type `upload_file`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import teltonika_rms_task_group.zero_touch 41
```
